labelChirho: to burn up, consume by fire (active)
descriptionChirho: To cause something to be consumed by fire, to burn completely (active/transitive uses of katakaiō with the intensifying kata- prefix).

labelChirho: to be burned up, consumed by fire (passive)
descriptionChirho: To be consumed or destroyed by fire (passive/intransitive uses indicating the subject undergoes burning).
